propositions: GitHub re-evaluates job-level if conditions during workflow cancellation; always() predicates remain true, preventing stale matrix and reusable jobs from being canceled.
Seven full-route jobs introduced by commit 6f4123678c with always() predicates continue execution until natural completion instead of being canceled when a patchset is superseded.
Stale full-route jobs must be canceled on same-patchset replacement while preserving cancellation behavior to fail-closed on classifier failure and keep full-route jobs eligible.
Full-route job predicates must be replaced with cancellation-aware status checks (!cancelled() && <existing conditions>) to enable prompt job cancellation on superseding patchsets.
Live same-change replacements demonstrate successor job creation proceeding without waiting for stale matrix/reusable jobs to finish naturally after the fix is applied.
